Let's check out some Retroid Pocket 6 accessories - including a screen protector and their official TPU grips.

Retroid accessories: https://tinyurl.com/Retroid-Accessories
Retroid Pocket 6: https://tinyurl.com/Retroid-RGC
RP6 review video: https://youtu.be/4ByeyqlasHY

These accessories were sent to me by Retroid for testing and feedback.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this video ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
